biography.text: Born in 1960 in Jersey City. Padin earned a B.A. from Rutgers University (1983), an M.S.W. from Fordham University (1985), and a J.D. from Seton Hall University School of Law (1992). She clerked in New Jersey Superior Court, practiced in Bloomfield and Jersey City for three decades, served briefly as a Jersey City municipal judge, and was counsel to a city landlord-tenant relations board. President Biden appointed her.
